newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X shares will not resume on TSE today.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X shares will not resume on TSE today.

text.p: Shares in avidly watched Bre-X Minerals Ltd will not resume trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Wednesday, the exchange said.
The stock traded for a little over 1-1/2 hours today before dealings were stopped because of technical difficulties.
Bre-X shares were available for trade for less than half an hour on Tuesday because of TSE system problems.
When the stock stopped trading, it was off 0.65 at 3.20 with a hefty 11.8 million shares changing hands.
